notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes: The First
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone that has left feedback on bugs or quirks that have been found in playing the demo! As of now, here are the bugs that have been tackled.

Removed some debug commands that found their way into the public demo.

Removed ability to click buttons when the almanac is open

Made escape key exit the almanac

Made main menu not require an additional button press if entire animation was watched

Reduced some dialogue that was just too dang long

Fixed some typos/duplicate text in dialogues

Fixed bug that caused chewing sounds to stop playing after a few items were eaten (sorry)

Add a couple additional helper arrows to make sure people can find the sewer

Add ability to disable controller rumble

Fix window placement inconsistencies

If you see any of these in the future - or if you find anything new - please let me know in a Steam Community post or on Discord! Thanks!
